mapper.select:
select `bc`.`active_date`, (select `abbreviation` from `base_organization` where `org_id` = `bc`.`active_org_id`) as `activeOrgName`, `bc`.`card_number`, (select `name` from `base_patient` where `patient_id` = `bc`.`patient_id`) as `cardOwner`, `bc`.`sold_target`, `bc`.`sold_phone_number`, `bc`.`sale_channel_name`, (select `employee_name` from `base_employee` where `user_id` = `bc`.`active_user_id`) as `activeUser` from `base_card` `bc` inner join `base_coupon` `b` on `b`.`coupon_id` = `bc`.`coupon_id` where `bc`.`coupon_id` = #{couponId} and `b`.`coupon_type` != 4 and `bc`.`status` in (2,3,4) and `bc`.`allocate_org_id` = 0
and `bc`.`card_number` like concat('%', #{cardNumber}, '%')
and `bc`.`sold_target` like concat('%', #{soldTarget}, '%')
and `bc`.`sale_channel_id` in
#{item}
and (`bc`.`active_date` >= #{activeStartDate} and `bc`.`active_date` < #{activeStartDate})
and `bc`.`active_org_id` in
#{item}
order by `bc`.`active_date` desc
